title: Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events
abstract: arXiv:2606.06295v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity $u(z)$, whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential $h(z)$, obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, $u$ and $h$ remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enh

translated_title: 反应通量匹配：稀有事件的机理发现与自适应采样
translated_abstract: 路径采样方法能够生成连接亚稳态的反应轨迹系综，但从这些数据中提取机理洞察仍然并非易事。我们提出了通量匹配这一框架，它直接从反应轨迹数据中学习两个互补的对象：其一是流速度 u(z)，其流线可描绘出主导的反应路径；其二是标量势 h(z)，它通过对反应流的加权亥姆霍兹-霍奇分解获得，可作为数据驱动的反应坐标。两者均在反应路径系综中最小化二次泛函，类似于生成建模中的流匹配损失，且无需了解底层动力学或平稳分布。与基于倾向函数的方法不同，u 和 h 在投影到非马尔可夫集合变量后仍保持良定义，并且它们的水平集进而为改进稀有事件的增强采样提供了自适应界面。
tldr: 提出通量匹配框架，直接从反应轨迹数据中学习流速度与标量势两个互补对象，分别用于揭示主导反应路径和构建数据驱动的反应坐标，并利用其水平集实现稀有事件的自适应增强采样。
en_tdlr: Flux Matching learns a current velocity and a scalar potential directly from reactive trajectory data to reveal dominant reaction pathways and provide data-driven reaction coordinates, enabling adaptive enhanced sampling of rare events.
